sample_rule: every verdict-bearing claim + random sample of at least 20% of the remainder
_instructions: Template for the C3 evidence-sample record. Scaffold a real one with freeze_records.py scaffold-c3, naming the verdict-bearing claims; the verifier reads each sampled claim's cited evidence against the claim (aee assess --verify-evidence / aee verify-evidence resolves refs and hashes; support is judged by the verifier), records verification per claim, and sets outcome PASS only when no verdict-bearing claim is unverified.
